cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Fair Exchange
cards.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Half an hour helping you move buys two hours painting my shed on Saturday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Saturday's my only lie-in. Can I come after lunch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Afternoon painting costs me cricket. Three hours, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hire a painter. But I need the sofa carried up three flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then two painter-hours covers loading; the stairs cost a third. Cricket's free again.

mechanism: A controls permission for repayment timing and recalculates the approved favor price as lost leisure and lifting effort change.
confusable: Ordinary bargaining over money would miss the specific pricing of time and inconvenience in equivalent future labor.
comparison: Moving stairs and hired painter time differ from the pan scene a small effort reduction and shopping obligations.
seedUse: The existing D46-b afternoon request is answered by a superior rate ruling, and the final revised painter-hours continue that same mechanism.
